encargo: Locked-off extreme telephoto shot, 8 seconds, filmed in slow motion as if at 48 frames per second, so everything feels enormous and heavy. No camera movement, no shake, no zoom. Seconds 0 to 1: nothing happens, only heat shimmer. Seconds 1 to 5: a tiny orange point of fire ignites at the base of the rocket and silently swells into a blinding fireball; steam lit amber from below rolls outward along the ground in slow, massive billows. Seconds 5 to 8: the rocket begins to lift off extremely slowly and perfectly vertically, rising less than one fifth of its own height, and arrives exactly at the last frame. The tower stays in place. No explosion, no debris, no birds. No markings, letters, flags or symbols on the rocket or the tower. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.

Locked-off extreme telephoto shot, 10 seconds, real time, no camera movement at all, as if on a heavy tripod. Only the air moves: heat shimmer ripples horizontally over the water and makes the distant rocket and tower waver slightly. A faint wisp of white vapour drifts sideways from the rocket and dissolves. The silhouettes do not move. The water stays mirror still. No ignition, no smoke, no flames, no birds, no zoom. No markings, letters, flags or symbols on the rocket, the tower or the cars. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
